name: Neptunium series ingrowth
description: A single compartment holding pure Pu-241, showing ingrowth down the 4n+1 chain: Pu-241 to Am-241 to Np-237 to U-233 to Th-229. Nothing moves between compartments here; every feature on the chart comes from the decay and ingrowth terms. The inventories are activities, so a daughter grows in at its own decay constant: Am-241 lives 30 times longer than the Pu-241 feeding it and its activity peaks 34 times lower. Set decay_unit to mol to count atoms instead, and the same run conserves the chain down it.
